name: Calculator
highLevelGoals: The user wants to be able to perform fundamental mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) accurately and efficiently using the calculator app.
The user aims to easily input numbers and select operations through a clear and responsive interface, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free calculation experience.
The user needs to see the results of their calculations displayed prominently and immediately, allowing for easy verification and understanding.
lowLevelGoals: The user inputs the first number of the calculation into the display.
The user selects the desired arithmetic operation (e.g., addition, subtraction) from the available buttons.
The user inputs the second number of the calculation into the display.
The user presses the equals button to trigger the calculation.
The user taps a numerical button (0-9) on the calculator interface.
The user taps an operation button (+, -, *, /) on the calculator interface.
The user taps the equals button (=) on the calculator interface.
The user taps the clear (C or AC) button to reset the current input or calculation.
The system displays the final calculated result in the main display area.
The system updates the display in real-time as the user inputs numbers and operations.
